IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Saturday 7 November
Winds: Southwesterly 15 to 25 knots tending westerly 10 to 15 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres around midday, then increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the afternoon.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 80% chance of showers.

Sunday 8 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots shifting southeasterly in the late afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Monday 9 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming east to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots during the day then tending north to northeasterly 10 to 15 knots during the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Tuesday 10 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming southeasterly 10 to 15 knots during the afternoon then shifting westerly below 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Mostly sunny.
IDT12420.synoptic: A cold southwesterly wind flow developed over the State in the wake of a front and will persist on Saturday. Another high pressure system moves close to Tasmania on Sunday, drifting away to the southeast from Monday. A trough is expected to approach from the west on Tuesday.
